newsitem.title: UK: BNP cancels $150 million perpetual step-up FRN.
newsitem.headline: BNP cancels $150 million perpetual step-up FRN.

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris has decided it will not proceed at the present time with its $150 million perpetual subordinated FRN originally launched on October 21, lead manager CS First Boston said on Monday.
BNP said the cancellation of the bond was as a result of press reports concerning the French government's possible sale of the state-owned domestic banking group CIC.
SocGen is also reported to be bidding for CIC.

BNP has informed CSFB that being bound by confidentiality obligations to the French government in connection with the bidding process for CIC, it can neither confirm nor nullify any information concerning the ongoing process.
The bond was scheduled to close on November 6, 1996.
